p1_certificate.statement: No T-to-CCZ distillation protocol with distance d >= 4 exists on N <= 9 qubits across all 1 <= n <= 63 (establishing N_CCZ(4) = 10), and no T-to-T protocol with d >= 4 exists on N <= 7 qubits (pipeline control).

p2_certificate.statement: No T-to-T distillation protocol with distance d >= 4 exists on N <= 8 qubits across all 1 <= n <= 127 (establishing N_T(4) >= 9 and resolving the 2-month open SAT instance of Jacinto et al., arXiv:2606.07734).
